reason: My architect already does the 3D models and renders and it's in their fee, and most of my clients come from referrals who already trust me. I get a lot of calls from people offering this kind of thing, so I'd pass.
objection: I'd be paying $1,500 a home for something my architect already covers inside their fee, and I don't need it to win clients who come by referral.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it handle my own plan better than my architect's renders, and it being something I could pass to the homeowner as a billable pre-construction line, so it pays for itself and cuts change orders.
